validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and operating. Independent + official corroboration all naming this line: official Egyptian Presidency national-projects registry (presidency.eg 'إنشاء خط غاز النوبارية-السادات'), independent daily Al-Shorouk (2014-10-03 ministry announcement 'انتهاء تنفيذ خطي غاز النوبارية-السادات وإدفو بـ590 مليون جنيه'), the egy-map projects aggregator, and argaam. SPECS: 73 km, 36 in, 12 million m3/day, cost 495 million EGP, completed September 2014 — agree across Al-Shorouk-family + presidency + petro-news; egy-map has minor variance (70 km / 700 million EGP) which I treat as an aggregator rounding, not a conflict (the 73/36/12/495 cluster dominates and matches the argaam ref that the sheet already cites). NOTE the Al-Shorouk headline's 590 million EGP is the COMBINED total for TWO projects (Nubaria-Sadat + Edfu, GEM P7588), so GEM's 495 million for this line alone is correct, not a contradiction. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission trunk — 36 in / 73 km national-grid line moving gas from northern high-pressure production (Burullus, Abu Qir) via Sadat City toward Dahshour to feed North Cairo / Abu Rawash / South Cairo power stations. Not gathering/process/feeder; not oil/NGL. DUPLICATE: actively checked vs roster + GulfPub. P3346 'El Noubareya Gas Pipeline' (El Noubareya->Al Qalyubia, 66 km, 32/42 in) is the DISTINCT Nubaria->Mit Nama/Qalyubia branch (presidency.eg lists 'المرحلتين الأولى والثانية من خط غاز النوبارية-ميت نما' separately; Mit Nama is in Qalyubia) — same Nubaria take-off node, different destination/specs, NOT the same pipe. No GulfPub Egypt feature corresponds to Nubaria-Sadat (no counterpart in the 95-feature roster). So no duplicate. ATTRIBUTION caveat: start province should be Beheira (El Nubaria town is in Beheira gov.), GEM says Alexandria; end Sadat City in Monufia is correct (egy-map confirms Menoufia). Owner in GEM = EGAS (holding) 100%; the transmission operator is GASCO — sources describe it as a petroleum-ministry national-grid project, consistent with EGAS/GASCO public ownership but not stated by name, so owner attribution is inferred/class-wide. The sheet's existing argaam ref verifies (200 + '73'/'36' present); the worklist auto-check falsely failed it on literal tokens 'operating' and '495,000,000' because the Arabic page uses 'تم الانتهاء' and '٤٩٥ مليون'.

routes.corridor_desc: The line runs from the El Nubaria grid node in northwestern Beheira governorate southeastward across the western Nile-Delta fringe / desert-edge toward Sadat City in Monufia governorate — a national-grid transmission link carrying gas from northern high-pressure production (Burullus, Abu Qir) via Sadat City onward toward Dahshour to feed the North Cairo / Abu Rawash / South Cairo power stations. Endpoint cities are firmly named by sources; the intervening corridor is not mapped, so the bound is loose (corridor is the ~50-70 km straight-line band between the two named cities, route length 73 km). Coordinates are city-centroid approximations for the two named endpoints, NOT surveyed pipeline vertices. egy-map's single map-center coordinate (~30.59N, 31.51E) plots near Qalyubia, inconsistent with a Nubaria->Sadat alignment, so it was NOT used.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from named cities in presidency.eg (Nubaria->Sadat) and egy-map (end governorate Menoufia). Coordinates are defensible city-centroid approximations (El Nubaria ~30.68N/30.10E in Beheira; Sadat City ~30.378N/30.502E in Monufia) — flagged approximate, not surveyed. No coordinates fabricated; egy-map's inconsistent map-center point was deliberately rejected. Intervening vertices unknown; corridor bound is loose.

summary: P3928 Nubaria-Sadat confirmed real & correctly classified (36in/73km/12MMcm-d/495M EGP/2014, high tier); caveats: start province Alexandria->Beheira, dead almalnews primary ref replaced by presidency.eg+Al-Shorouk, owner EGAS unconfirmed by name.
